pages.title: Relaying Resonance
pages.text: A crystal left behind by a failed purification seems able to balance energy automatically. From what I can observe, it adjusts its resonance frequency according to the proportion of energy at each node. Could this be used to extend the distance over which resonance can be transmitted?
